harness.note: Cross-origin frame. Harness served from 127.0.0.1, games are remote https origins. The standalone harness mirrors the player sandbox and permission configuration.

method.assetBudgetEnforcementStatus: Enforcement was configured for this run but did not fire. The route guard tested a state flag that the byte counter never set, so no request was aborted once the budget estimate was passed. Cancellation is therefore NOT established for any session in this run; the two flagged sessions were measured, not stopped. Correction applied afterwards in scripts/iframe-audit.mjs (the state flag is now set, plus a pre-body guard that refuses known large-asset resources as the remaining budget runs down); an actual rerun is required before any enforcement claim can be made for the real hosts.
method.byteAccounting: Bytes are estimates: the sum of declared response Content-Length headers, cross-checked against Playwright request.sizes() responseBodySize, reported as the larger of the two. These are not measured transferred bytes — compressed, chunked or header-less responses are missed, WebSocket traffic is not counted, and the same bytes may be counted once per observed response.
limitationsOfMethod: Frame document presence is not gameplay. No human play was performed.
No permission inference: missing framing headers are not evidence of permission to embed.

Game assets are not downloaded deliberately; a session that exceeds the asset budget stops being observed, and with enforcement active further requests are aborted. Enforcement was inactive for this run, so no session in this run was actually stopped.

Bytes are estimates: the sum of declared response Content-Length headers, cross-checked against Playwright request.sizes() responseBodySize, reported as the larger of the two. These are not measured transferred bytes — compressed, chunked or header-less responses are missed, WebSocket traffic is not counted, and the same bytes may be counted once per observed response.

Partial duplicate of the byte-accounting caveat: Playwright request.sizes() may not fire at all for cross-origin out-of-process subresources, in which case only declared Content-Length headers contributed to the estimate.
Edge headless (no GPU) may behave differently from a GPU-accelerated desktop browser.
One run per game; no retry. Transient network conditions are not separated from steady state.
